thesisQuality.note: Large diversified generation/retail platform addresses durable firm-power demand, tempered by unproven post-close synergy capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: TTM revenue and net income remain substantial and positive, but Calpine leverage/integration and remedy execution reduce certainty.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: At $254.71 and 24.66 trailing P/E, valuation has plausible headroom after a pullback but is not independently demonstrated as compelling across scenarios.

catalystScore.note: Calpine integration and regulatory-remedy completion are material identifiable catalysts, but realized timing/economics remain uncertain.

governancePower.note: Management executed a large strategic acquisition and monetizing remedy assets, but current evidence is insufficient for exceptional long-duration stewardship claims.

alignment2036.note: Nuclear plus dispatchable gas/geothermal capacity directly serves durable electrification, reliability and data-center power needs across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Combined generation technologies and competitive retail platform create multiple demand engines and cross-market reuse.

bottleneckControl.note: Large firm-generation fleet participates directly in scarce reliable-power capacity; divestitures prevent a higher assessment.

scenarioRobustness.note: Nuclear, gas and geothermal diversification improves resilience across power scenarios, offset by integration/regulatory exposure.

substitutionResilience.note: Firm nuclear/dispatchable generation has meaningful replacement barriers for continuous load, while alternative generation/storage and transmission solutions remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Technology and regional generation diversity provide some redundancy, but current evidence does not establish exceptional fuel/equipment supply-chain redundancy.

pricingPower.note: Scale and firm-power scarcity support value capture, but current cited evidence does not establish structurally protected pricing across cycles.

risk.note: Material integration complexity, assumed Calpine debt, regulatory remedies/divestitures, gas/fuel exposure and successor transmission bottlenecks create meaningful but non-thesis-breaking risk.

confidence.note: Identity/tradability and transaction facts are primary-sourced and current market data is independently sourced; detailed realized post-close synergies, full balance-sheet integration and supplier concentration remain uncertain.

thesis: CEG controls a large, diversified firm-power platform positioned for long-duration electricity demand growth, with nuclear scarcity and Calpine diversification creating durable strategic relevance if integration economics hold.
keyRisk: Calpine leverage/integration and regulatory remedies could erode expected scale economics while transmission constraints become the successor bottleneck.
nextCatalyst: Demonstrated post-Calpine operating results, synergy realization and deleveraging/remedy completion.

scoreBreakdown.note: Weighted arithmetic using Methodology 1.0.0 scoreWeights; risk and confidence are reported separately and not silently embedded into the component score.
